title_en: Chinese Science Fiction (1/20): A Signal from Deep Space
note_en: This text uses 把 again and again: 她把信号记录下来 "she recorded the signal," 她决定第二天早上把结果交给研究所的负责人 "she decided to hand her results to the head of the institute the next morning." 把 moves the object in front of the verb, so the sentence focuses on what happens to that object, and the verb must be followed by something extra, such as a result (下来) or a destination (给…). English simply says "verb + object," so learners often forget that a bare verb can't end a 把 sentence.
